title: Senate Lobbying
description: A senator or corporate representative needs help influencing a Senate vote on an important bill. It's all perfectly legal—just strategic conversations, a few favors called in. The New Republic runs on relationships, and they need someone who understands that. Can you help ensure the right outcome?
shortDescription: Help influence a Senate vote through political maneuvering

objectives.description: Gather support for the bill through conversations and favors
